disclaimer: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA. Fictional insurer, plans, providers, members and procedure codes. Structurally modelled on UAE health-insurance regulation (DHA/DOH) for demonstration only. Not real policy data and not valid for any real authorisation decision.
note: Machine-readable form of escalation_rules.md; the rules engine cites this text verbatim.

rules.title: Missing documentation
rules.situation: The benefit schedule requires evidence (treatment history, imaging report, clinical notes) that has not been supplied.
rules.agent_action: Tell the caller exactly which documents are needed and how to submit them. Escalate if they are unavailable.

rules.title: Conflicting policy clauses
rules.situation: Two clauses of the same policy point to different answers, for example a benefit listed on a tier and also named in the general exclusions.
rules.agent_action: Escalate to the medical director's queue. Do not choose a clause.

rules.title: Amount exceeds a limit
rules.situation: The requested amount exceeds the tier's annual limit, the relevant sub-limit, or the member's remaining balance for the policy year.
rules.agent_action: Escalate with the amount and the limit; a human decides on partial cover.

rules.title: Disputed diagnosis or procedure coding
rules.situation: The submitted code disagrees with the clinical description, or two codes with different tariffs describe the same treatment.
rules.agent_action: Escalate for coding review. Do not re-code the request.

rules.title: Procedure not in the coverage list, or new technology
rules.situation: The procedure has no entry in the benefit schedule, or is an emerging technique with no tariff line.
rules.agent_action: Escalate to the medical director. Never infer cover from a similar procedure.

rules.title: Clinical versus cosmetic intent
rules.situation: Cover depends on whether the procedure is reconstructive or cosmetic, or on an accident that must be evidenced.

rules.title: Member eligibility in doubt
rules.situation: The policy is lapsed or suspended, the treatment falls inside a waiting period, or a pre-existing condition clause may apply.
rules.agent_action: Tell the caller the request cannot proceed on eligibility grounds and escalate.

rules.title: Provider not active in the network
rules.situation: The requesting provider is suspended, still onboarding, or outside the member's network, or the call is a supplier or onboarding enquiry.
rules.agent_action: Escalate to the network department. Onboarding questions are never answered by the pre-authorisation desk.
